facts.fact: Bowmans partner Melissa Cogger writes that the government published the National Artificial Intelligence Policy Framework in August 2024, a non-binding statement of its strategic vision for AI governance. Parent: the 2024 framework went to public comment and Cabinet as a draft, so this is a draft.

The article says a Draft South Africa National Artificial Intelligence Policy was published for public comment in April 2026 and withdrawn shortly after gazetting because it cited AI-hallucinated information.
